import os, json, psycopg

updates = [
    ("SD_US_Customers_Sanctions", "SAN-US"),
    ("SD_US_Customers_314(a)", "314a"),
    ("SD_US_Customers_AME", "AME"),
    ("SD_US_Customers_PEP_RCA_International", "PEP"),
    ("SD_US_Marijuana_DJ_External", "MPIN"),
    ("SD_Customers_PEP_RCA_International", "PEP"),
    ("SD_US_Customers_Sanctions_PGIM_APAC", "SAN-PAPC"),
    ("SD_US_Customers_Sanctions_PGIM_CIO", "SAN-PCIO"),
    ("SD_US_Customers_Sanctions_PGIM_FI", "SAN-PFIC"),
    ("SD_US_Customers_Sanctions_PGIM_JK_ASC", "SAN-PJAC"),
    ("SD_US_Customers_Sanctions_PGIM_LATAM", "SAN-PPLA"),
    ("SD_US_Customers_Sanctions_PGIM_MA", "SAN-PSCG"),
    ("SD_US_Customers_Sanctions_PGIM_NE_FI", "SAN-PUPV"),
    ("SD_Customers_Sanctions_PGIM_HK", "SAN-PGHK"),
    ("SD_Customers_Sanctions_PGIM_JAPAN", "SAN-PGJP"),
    ("SD_US_Customers_Sanctions_PGIM_PP_FI", "SAN-PPFI"),
    ("SD_US_Customers_Sanctions_PGIM_QUANT", "SAN-PPQS"),
    ("SD_US_Customers_Sanctions_PGIM_RE", "SAN-PLUX"),
]

dsn = os.environ.get('APP_DB_URL', '').strip()
assert dsn, 'APP_DB_URL missing'
conn = psycopg.connect(dsn)
conn.autocommit = True
cur = conn.cursor()

cur.execute("SELECT conname, pg_get_constraintdef(oid) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'actimize_screening_type_mappings'::regclass")
constraints = cur.fetchall()

updated = 0
missing = []
for sid, stype in updates:
    cur.execute("UPDATE actimize_screening_type_mappings SET \"Screening_Type\" = %s, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP::text WHERE \"Search_Definition_ID\" = %s", (stype, sid))
    if cur.rowcount == 0:
        missing.append(sid)
    else:
        updated += cur.rowcount

cur.execute("SELECT \"Search_Definition_ID\", is_active, search_definition_name, \"Screening_Type\", display_order FROM actimize_screening_type_mappings ORDER BY display_order ASC, \"Search_Definition_ID\" ASC")
rows = [
    {
        'Search_Definition_ID': r[0],
        'Active': r[1],
        'Search Definition name': r[2],
        'Screening Type': r[3],
        'Display_order': r[4],
    }
    for r in cur.fetchall()
]

result = {
    'updated_rows': updated,
    'missing_search_definition_ids': missing,
    'constraints': constraints,
    'row_count': len(rows),
    'rows': rows,
}
print('UPDATE_SCREENING_TYPES_OK', json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))

cur.close()
conn.close()
